main_body: Three small powder kegs stacked in a pyramid, each drawn as a front-on barrel with red bands and a dark brown outline
top_band: none: the column at x=8 runs a dark outline at row 2, then one mid-tone face (L=108) at rows 3-6, then dark rows 7-11. There is no lighter horizontal band and no ellipse top.
evidence: Each keg is a flat rectangular face with horizontal bands and a dark outline. The scan shows no lighter top surface above any keg (x=5, 8 and 10 all go outline, face, outline). The guide's barrel needs an ellipse top and this has none. The kegs look like flat front-facing slabs, so it fails as a front elevation.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 7 distinct colours and a median of 0 colours per full tile because the piece is smaller than a tile. The references have 38-40 colours and 17-20 colours per tile. The kegs use about 3 steps (light wood, red band, dark red) with no grain, per-stave shading or highlights, so they read as thin and sticker-like. The outline is a tinted dark brown (0% neutral), which is fine, but the shading and texture are far below the references.
